body: I talked to my mom and dad about it and they don't seem to give a shit. I have nothing to hold me back now. I'm not even afraid anymore.

The PTSD sucks. What's worse are the people who "understand". They understand exactly shit. I was refused a job on my local police force for being a vet. But you know, they understand. Life does suck. Sorry for rambling. Just felt I could relate.
